name: ContextLift
author: ContextLift

sections.description:
ContextLift is a free, fully functional SEO automation plugin that helps you optimize your WordPress site’s internal linking structure, analyze click depth, and ensure your content hierarchy is sound.

Our powerful Context Engine learns about your content as you publish, intelligently mapping primary and secondary keywords, and proactively suggesting rich, contextual internal links to boost your SEO performance.

Key Features

  • Smart Internal Linking: Automatically suggests contextual internal links based on your content and mapped keywords.
  • Click Depth Analyzer: Visualize how far your pages are from the home page. Ensure search engines can easily crawl and index your most important content.
  • Heading Audit: Analyze your posts to ensure correct H1-H6 heading hierarchy, catching missing or empty headings, with one-click auto-fix and bulk fix.
  • Keyword Mapping: Effortlessly map out primary and secondary keywords for every piece of content.
  • Link Log & Revisions: Keep track of every internal link inserted by ContextLift, with full rollback support if you change your mind.
  • Bulk Internal Linking: Automatically link all orphan pages in silo-safe batches.
  • Scheduled Rebuilds: Automatic daily light scans and weekly full context rebuilds via WP-Cron.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services during normal operation. All processing is performed locally on your WordPress server.

The plugin UI includes a “License” settings tab which is a legacy stub. No data is transmitted to any external server through this tab.

If you previously activated a license key on an older version of this plugin, those keys were validated against the Lemon Squeezy service (api.lemonsqueezy.com). That functionality has been removed. For reference:
* Lemon Squeezy Terms of Service
* Lemon Squeezy Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contextlift directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ContextLift settings in your admin dashboard to configure your linking preferences.
  4. Click “Rebuild Context” to scan your existing content. All features are available immediately.
sections.faq:
Does ContextLift slow down my site?

No. ContextLift algorithms run in the WordPress admin panel and utilize background cron jobs to process large tasks, ensuring your front-end site speed remains completely unaffected.

How do I undo links added by ContextLift?

Navigate to the “Link Log” tab in the ContextLift dashboard. From there, you can view all inserted links and revert them with a single click.

Can I exclude certain categories from automatic linking?

Yes! In the Settings tab, you can select which categories the plugin should ignore when looking for link targets.

Are all features free?

Yes. All features — including bulk linking, heading auto-fix, click depth analysis, and scheduled rebuilds — are fully free and functional for all users.

  • Removed license validation and all feature gates per WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Removed Lemon Squeezy API integration (no external calls).
  • Scheduled context rebuilds (daily/weekly) now run for all users.
  • Bulk linking, heading auto-fix, and click depth analyzer are now available to everyone.

1.3.0

  • Initial stable release for WordPress directory submission.
  • Added Context Engine, Internal Linking, and Click Depth modules.
